description: This file defines a trait 'DataTypeErrorsBase' containing methods for converting data types, values, and identifiers to SQL-compatible strings, as well as utility functions related to SQL syntax and context handling within Apache Spark.

classes.name: DataTypeErrorsBase
classes.description: A trait providing methods for converting data types, values, and identifiers into SQL syntax, and utility functions for SQL context handling.

methods.name: toSQLId
methods.description: Converts attribute name parts into a SQL identifier string.

methods.name: toSQLStmt
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase SQL statement.

methods.name: toSQLConf
methods.description: Converts a configuration string into SQL format.

methods.name: toSQLType
methods.description: Converts a string or data type into its SQL type representation.

methods.name: toSQLValue
methods.description: Converts various data types into their SQL string representations.

methods.name: quoteByDefault
methods.description: Quotes a string with double quotes for SQL syntax.

methods.name: getSummary
methods.description: Retrieves the summary from a QueryContext.

methods.name: getQueryContext
methods.description: Returns an array containing the provided QueryContext or an empty array if null.

methods.name: toDSOption
methods.description: Quotes an option string for SQL.
